tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal chab gtor mdor bsdus tshogs gnyis kyi gru chen bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru mañju nā thā ya/ rnal 'byor pa gang zhig thun mtshams su 'jam dpal chab gtor gtong bar 'dod na/ rin po che'i snod bzang po gas chag med pa'i nang du/ 'bru dang*/ sman/ rin po che'i dri bzang dang*/ dar zab/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i zlum gtor ram/ ril bu lnga snod lngar bshams la/ spos bsreg cing*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam chos dang*// tshogs mchog rnams la bdag skyabs mchi// yon tan rgya mtsho khyod rnams la// bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi// sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir// byang chub sems dag bdag gis bskyed// gang gis bsod nams nyer bsags rnams// rdzogs pa'i byang chub bdag gis bsngo// 'gro 'di kun la phan mdzad phyir// dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed gyur// ces lan gsum gyi skyabs sems sngon du btang*/ skad cig gis paṃ las pad+ma// a las zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma ste/ gdan sum brtsegs kyi steng du muṃ dmar ser las ral gri yu ba muṃ dmar ser gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri dpung pa'i thad sor 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pa'i 'theb srin gyis ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba rgyas pa'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung du bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan zhing*/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan par gsal ba'i spyi bor hūm̐ yig zhu ba la thim pas lus thams cad rdo rje'i go cha zhu lugs su bgos par gyur bar bsam/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ/ ci 'grub bzla/ gtor mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su muṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i gtor mgron rigs bzhis bsdus pa'i mchod pa dang sbyin yul du gyur pa thams cad skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyong zhing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// bla ma rgyal ba rgyal sras thugs rje can// dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron kun gshegs su gsol// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs// mgon po yon tan mgron kun gshegs su gsol// skye ba gtan gyi pha mar gyur pa yi// rigs drug snying rje'i mgron kun gshegs su gsol// 'khrul pa'i dbang gis gnod byed 'byung po bgegs// lan chags bu lon mgron kun gshegs su gsol/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bcom ldan 'khor bcas byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod gtor bzhes slad du// dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// stong sum kun dang mnyam pa yi// pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// pad+ma ā sa na tiṣ+ṭha s+t+waṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rab 'byams zhing gi mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*| |me tog spos dang mar me dri yi chu// zhal zas rol mos srid pa gsum bkang ste// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// sems can rnams kyi don kun mdzad du gsol| |oṃ artsa na s+ya man+t+ri ta ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu| |mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi// gtor ma dang po chus bran te/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sbyong ba chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags rgya ni/ thal mo khong stong snying gar sbyar la// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gtor ma'i ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs te stong pa nyid du gyur// spel ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya ni/ rdo rje nang bsdams cung zad lhod pa khong stong byas te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ mgron rigs so sor mos pa dang mthun pa'i yo byad rnams kyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par gyur/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags rgya ni/ rdor thal kha phye ba gyen du bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ thams cad kyang sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ spyod par dbang ba shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags rgya ni/ g.yon sdigs mdzub snying gar bsgreng g.yas sdigs mdzub gtor ma la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin mtha' yas pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi spyod yul du 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bar gyur/ ye shes skar mda'i sngags rgya ni/ g.yas sdigs mdzub snying gar bsgreng*/ g.yon thal mo bkan nas gtor ma 'degs pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te/ na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi sam+bha wa sa ma ya/ ma hā ma ṇi/ du ru du ru| hṛ da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ lus zhing gi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa 'phags pa rnams la phul bas mnyes shing*/ sems can rnams kyang yo byad la rtsod pa med cing mthun pa'i bsam pa dang ldan par gyur/

dbang sgyur 'khor lo'i sngags rgya ni/ lag gnyis kyi mthe bong gnyis dang*/ mdzub chung gnyis te bzhi po so sor bsgreng*/ sor mo gzhan drug gi tshigs pa dang po rnams bsnol te/ leb mor byas pa kha sbub pa smin mtshams su bcas la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ gra he shwa ri pra bhañja dza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ thams cad kyang dam tshig la gnas pas bdag cag la phan pa dang bde ba la sogs pa phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du sgrub par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de ltar yang sngags re re lan gsum gsum brjod cing*/ phyag rgya rnams phyogs bcur bstan la bya'o// de nas/ oṃ rat+na sarkā ra s+ya man+t+ri ta ṇaṃ sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ yi dam bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la sogs pa/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang*/ theg pa rim pa dgus bsdus ba'i yi dam zhi khro rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ de rnams kyi shugs 'gro la sogs pa/ mdor na bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad la 'bul lo| |khyod rnams mnyes shing tshims nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur ba nyid du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo// zhes so/

gtor ma gnyis pa chus bran la/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin rlabs gong ltar byas la/ oṃ nā tha gu ṇa s+ya man+t+ri ta ṇaṃ sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi drug /gur zhal/ beng*/ ma ning*/ stag zhon/ trak+shad/ rnam thos sras/ a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma la sogs pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos skyong srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed dgu/ rgyal chen sde bzhi/ gtsang ris kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga/ lha klu mi yi drang srong bram ze phan gnod kyi dmod pa 'dor zhing bden tshig grub pa rnams dang*/ dzaṃ bha la dkar ser dmar nag /tshogs kyi bdag po/ gnod sbyin pho dgu/ mo dgu la sogs pa nor lha'i tshogs rnams dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i lha rnams dang*/ 'go ba'i lha lnga la sogs pa bdag cag 'khor bcas la srung skyob byed pa'i lha tshogs thams cad la 'bul lo// bzhes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams yun ring zhabs pad brtan pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun zhing bslab pa gsum la nan tan gces spras dang mi 'bral ba dang*/ 'khor lo gnyis kyi bya bas dus 'da' ba dang*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srung zhing skyob pa dang*/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ gtor ma gsum pa sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin rlabs sngar ltar byas rjes/ mchod pa'i tshab tu de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/

lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dre dang lha dang lha min mi dang dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro'i skye gnas rnams kyis bsdus pa'i 'gro ba rigs drug sems can thams cad dang*/ sa bdag sa yi lha mo brtan mas gtso byas 'dzam bu'i gling gi gnas bdag gzhi bdag dkor bdag /bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis| chos rje'i dge bsnyen chen po bzhi/ tsog sna'i rnam rgyal dkar po/ klu chen rigs lnga/ sa bdag dang gnyan gyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par sa phyogs yul phyogs dgon gnas grong khyer 'di dag la gnas pa'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang*/ pho rgyud mo rgyud klu rgyud gsum gyis bsdus pa'i snang srid kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad| 'phrog ma ma bu 'brog gnas yul 'khor skyong ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo// bzhes nas bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar gcod mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ gtor ma bzhi pa sngags drug phyag rgya drug /de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan rnams gong ltar brjod la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bi nā ya kas gtso byas pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ gdon rigs stong phrag bco brgyad/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ nad bdag rims bdag yams bdag mtshon dang mu ge 'thab rtsod kyi bdag po bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs ngos zin pa dang*/ ma zin pa rnams dang*/ bdag cag gi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du brdegs brdungs na tsha'i lan chags pa| brkus phrogs zas nor gyi lan chags pa/ bsad bcad srog gi lan chags pa/ tshe 'dir spyan zur dang thugs zur la phog pa sogs/ lan chags bu lon zhe 'khon ma 'khor bar rtsod cing rnyog pa thams cad la 'bul lo// thams cad gnod 'tshe gdug rtsub kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad nye bar zhi nas/

phan pa dang bde ba byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis myur du skye ba dang*/ lan chags bu lon 'khor zhe 'khon dag /nad rims mtshon 'khrug mu ge'i bskal pa thams cad rgyun chad pa dang*/ gnod byed thams cad kyang gtor ma 'dis mnyes shing tshims nas phan bde mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i grogs su gyur cig /gtor ma lnga pa'i nang du/ gong ma bzhi gshegs pa'i bshal chu yang blugs te/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan gong ltar dang*/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ gtor ma la re ba'i 'byung po glo bur du lhags pa rnams dang*/ khas zhan pa/ dbang chung ba/ skal ba chad pa/ ma mthong ba/ ma sleb pa/ ma khom pa/ lhag ma dang bshal chu la dbang ba thams cad la sbyin no// thams cad zas skom gyis tshims shing*/ so so'i re 'dod bskangs te dag pa'i zhing du skye bar gyur cig /ces brjod la gshegs/ slar gtor snod rnams chus bkang la/ stong gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// mar me dri chab zhal zas dang*// rol mor bcas pa'i mchod sprin ni// dngos 'byor yid kyis rab sprul te// kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin tshogs// mchod 'os rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra artsa na s+ya man+t+ri ta ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shapada'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra/ */bsung ba'i dri dang bda' ba'i ro/ */'jam pa'i reg bya 'dod yon lnga/ */rnam bzhi'i mgron kyi tshogs la 'bul/ */so sor bzhes la phrin las mdzod/ */ oṃ tsa tur man+t+ri tā sa pa ri wā ra rū pa/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ zhes mchod/ mchod yul gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// sbyin yul 'og ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*| |rigs drug pha ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// lan chags bu lon rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// rnam bzhi'i mgron kyi tshogs bcas la// tshad med mchod gtor 'di phul bas| |bdag cag 'khor bcas tshogs rdzogs nas// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// ces dang*/

bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// rgyu las 'gog pa gang yin pa// dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs// sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin| |chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*// rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin// der ni gsal dag rnyog pa med// sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid ni// bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs// rang bzhin med cing gnas med par// chos rnams de ltar shes nas su// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye// zhes chos sbyin bya/ 'jig rten pa'i mgron rigs rnams kyis tshe 'khor pa thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib/ dam tshig nyams chags/ nyes ltung dri ma mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs byed pa'i 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga te= zhes sbyong ba'i rtsa rig dang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṅka ni= zhes mi 'khrugs pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaṃḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca/ badz+ri bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa ā'aḥ zhes yig brgya brjod/

rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam skong gyur cig /rigs drug 'dod pa tshim gyur cig /lan chags bu lon 'khor gyur cig /sha 'khon sdig sgrib byang gyur cig /bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin stobs dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// rnam bzhi'i mgron rnams ma lus pa'i// bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces bden stobs brjod/ ma 'byor yongs su ma rnyed cing*// bdag rmongs blo yis gang bgyis pa'i// chad lhag nongs par gyur pa dag /de kun khyod kyis bzod par mdzod// ces bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ji lta'i rjes mthun dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra muḥ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa'i// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad dag ni 'gro bar gyis| sarba bhū ta gats+tshaḥ zhes se gol gyi sgra dang bcas gshegs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mañju nā tha badz+ra kro dha ya mā ri ma ma kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes bdag srung*/ shis pa brjod/ bdag cag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po 'di'i mthu la brten nas bdag cag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cig /bdag gi rgyud la sogs dang*/ bdag nam 'chi ba'i tshe gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal mi 'byung bar sogs kyis smon lam btab/ gzhan yang bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa'o// de ltar 'jam dpal chab gtor mdor bsdus pa 'di'ang*/ rang gzhan thams cad la phan pa'i lhag bsam dkar po nye bar bzhag ste/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas/ chu pho rta lo dbo'i zla ba'i dkar po'i bzang po gsum pa'i dus dge bar chu klung chen po nā gārdzu na'i sgra 'byin pa'i ngogs/

'bri dam pa chos phyug gi klung pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig lcang lo can gsang sngags kyi gan mdzod chen por bris pa sems can thams cad tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
